name: bg-animated-gradient

frames.best_why: The violet-to-magenta blend is at its most varied, with indigo and a warm orange patch showing.

tagline: A full-screen violet-to-pink gradient drifts and slowly changes hue.
summary: A full-bleed animated gradient built from layered radial colour spots that smoothly cross-fade and drift, meant to sit behind page content.
appearance: The whole stage is a soft blurry blend of violet, indigo and magenta with hints of orange. There are no shapes or edges, only broad radial glows that fade into one another.
behaviour: The colour spots drift and cross-fade on a linear loop that reverses at each end, so the whole field slides between violet, magenta and blue.
demo_content: Centred white label reading Animated Gradient Background.
search_phrases: colour shifting background for a hero
vibrant gradient loop for a landing page
use_when: A hero needs a calm, colourful backdrop that moves slowly enough to keep text readable.
avoid_when: It loops forever and is purely decorative; the saturated purple fights dark or brand-coloured content.
customise: gradients takes colour stops with centre points and animationDuration sets the loop; anything else needs a new gradient array in the demo.
weight_why: One div animating its background gradient; no canvas or extra nodes.

a11y.note: Decorative with no content of its own; the infinite background animation has no reduced-motion check.

issues: No reduced-motion handling for the endless gradient loop.
The saturated gradient can cut the contrast of white text placed on it.
polish_why: Smooth, vivid blend with no banding; it is a familiar gradient backdrop with nothing more.
